id: title:aspicer:spread alert checks over a window after each interval

review.posthog_relevance: Changes scheduling implementation for alert checks, including UUID assignment, offset calculation, and frontend schedule restriction messages.
review.reason: The change group demonstrates a substantive, bounded implementation of alert scheduling. P1.F1.H3 and P1.F1.H4 show the assignment of UUIDs and the use of scheduling offsets in backend checks. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F7.H6/H7 show the integration of these offsets into calendar and schedule calculations. P1.F10.H1 and P1.F10.H2 show corresponding frontend updates. While the exact production
review.uncertainty: The score relies on the assumption that the backend implementation of alert_check_offset and the complete scheduling workflow are present and functional, though not fully shown in this chunk. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation and test assertions, not on unverified production outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are used. No tier is assigned; score is withheld.

observations.behavior: Adds alert_id parameter and offset-dependent scheduling, including a new offset calculation and its use in next_calendar_check_time.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows each alert to have a unique offset into its scheduled interval, rather than sharing a global phase. This could support per-alert scheduling or offset configuration.

observations.behavior: Replaces shared interval delta with per-alert offset and shared local period start, while retaining the same cadence and DST handling.
